attchmntText: HCL Technologies Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Release    HCLTech and Cohere partner to build and deliver sovereign AI '.
voiceSummary: HCL Technologies Ltd. announced a partnership with Cohere to build and deliver sovereign AI solutions for enterprises and governments. HCLTech becomes a preferred global systems integrator partner for Cohere in Canada and Germany. The collaboration combines Cohere’s sovereign AI platform, including the North agentic AI platform, with HCLTech’s professional services and advanced AI capabilities. Initial focus areas include insurance, financial services, and manufacturing. Solutions will address data residency, security, and regulatory requirements. Both companies hold ISO 42001 certification. HCLTech reported consolidated revenues of $14.8 billion for the twelve months ending September 2026. The announcement was issued on November 17, 2026.
